name: Berserker Initiate
description: A raging warrior who imbibes ritualistic concoctions to enhance their form with aspects of a predatory beast.

abilities.name: Pack Fury
abilities.description: The Initiate gains a +1 bonus to their attack rolls for each ally within Very Close range of their attack’s target.

abilities.name: Berserker Rage
abilities.description: The first time in a scene the Initiate marks their last Stress, they gain a +4 bonus to damage rolls.
